description:
Hi, I'm Cal Renner. I've spent about forty years working on rural homes — framing them, wiring them, digging wells, and helping families put up a place they could actually afford. Along the way I learned how to build, power, heat, cool, and water a home without depending on a bank or a stack of monthly bills.

Here's my complete off-grid method in one manual — build & run a home you own, and cut $10,000+ a year in bills: https://calrenner.com/

On this channel I share those methods straight: how ordinary people buy land without overpaying, put up a home for a fraction of what a contractor quotes, and run it on sun, wood, and rainwater.

New videos regularly. Subscribe if you want the honest version of off-grid living.
